text: As I stand amidst colorful displays and shifting light, I am engulfed by the energy of inquiry and innovation. The environment urges me to reflect on the nature of research and development—what it means to connect, to innovate, to coexist with technology. I feel a curious tension between the sterility of glass and steel and the imaginative playfulness of the exhibit design. This moment inspires a meditative wonder and a sense that I am on the threshold of new knowledge.
